cohort: The study participants were patients who had deliveries at a regional hospital over a nine-month period.
finding: Quantitative measurement of blood loss identified substantially high rates of undiagnosed postpartum hemorrhage, and African American and Hispanic/Latina women were more likely to be diagnosed with PPH compared to Caucasian women.
mod_finding: Estimated blood loss was underestimated for vaginal deliveries and overestimated for cesarean deliveries, and high rates of undiagnosed PPH were observed for both cesarean (84%) and vaginal (89%) deliveries based on QBL >1000 mL and >500 mL respectively.
